contexts.title: Environmental Monitoring
contexts.definition: Observations of the environment at fixed sites, as OGC SensorThings and EPA WQX describe them: the stations that measure air, water, tide and weather, the values they record, and reported releases into the environment.

contexts.title: Urban Forest
contexts.definition: Trees growing in a city's streets and public land, as municipal and nonprofit tree inventories record them and as the OpenTrees crosswalk normalizes them: species, size, planting and condition.

concepts.definition: A fixed place where an agency or network repeatedly measures the environment (air, water, tide, weather), identified by its operator's station code and located by coordinates; measured values are recorded against it over time.

fields.name: siteId
fields.description: Operator's station code, e.g. WQX MonitoringLocationIdentifier, AQS site id, NOAA station id

fields.name: siteType
fields.description: Kind of site, e.g. River/Stream, Estuary, Well

fields.name: operatorId
fields.description: Code of the organization that runs the site

fields.name: watershedCode
fields.description: USGS hydrologic unit code (HUC) the site drains to

fields.name: stateCode
fields.description: State FIPS code

fields.name: countyCode
fields.description: County FIPS code

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields shared by OGC SensorThings 1.1 Thing/Location, the EPA WQX Station profile (Water Quality Portal), USGS Water Data monitoring locations, EPA AirNow monitor sites (AQSID, SiteName, Latitude/Longitude, Elevation) and NOAA CO-OPS station metadata (id, name, lat, lon).

concepts.definition: One measured value of an environmental property (such as dissolved oxygen, ozone or water level) taken at a fixed station at a given time, carrying its unit, the method or sensor used, a statistic and a quality or approval status.

fields.name: siteId
fields.description: The station's siteId (Monitoring Site)

fields.name: seriesId
fields.description: The time series / datastream this value belongs to

fields.name: observedProperty
fields.description: What was measured, e.g. 'Dissolved oxygen (DO)', 'Ozone'

fields.name: parameterCode
fields.description: USGS 5-digit parameter code, e.g. 00300

fields.name: phenomenonTime
fields.description: When the measured value applies

fields.name: unit
fields.description: Unit code of the value, e.g. mg/L, degC, PPB

fields.name: method
fields.description: Analytical method, sensor or procedure used

fields.name: statistic
fields.description: Statistic the value represents, e.g. instantaneous, daily mean

fields.name: qualityStatus
fields.description: Approval/review status, e.g. Provisional, Accepted, preliminary

fields.name: qualifier
fields.description: Qualifier or flag codes on the value

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields shared by OGC SensorThings 1.1 Observation/Datastream/ObservedProperty/Sensor, the EPA WQX result profile (CharacteristicName, ResultMeasureValue, ResultMeasure/MeasureUnitCode, USGSPCode, ResultStatusIdentifier, MeasureQualifierCode, StatisticalBaseCode), USGS latest-continuous (parameter_code, statistic_id, approval_status, qualifier), NOAA CO-OPS datagetter (t, v, f, q) and AirNow.

concepts.definition: A reported release of oil, chemicals, sewage or another substance into the environment, recorded by an emergency-response agency with when and where it happened, what was released and what caused it.

fields.name: town
fields.description: Municipality where it happened

fields.name: location
fields.description: Free-text address or place; can be a private residence

fields.name: description
fields.description: Free-text account of the release

fields.name: incidentType
fields.description: e.g. Sewage Incident, Motor Vehicle Accident, Dielectric Fluid

fields.name: cause
fields.description: What caused it, e.g. Equipment Failure, Natural Cause

fields.name: substances
fields.description: What was released

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from the CT DEEP Spill Incidents dataset (incident_id, reported_date, incident_date, township, incident_address, incident_description, incident_type, incident_source, chemicals). Only one source was verified; no federal schema was mapped.

concepts.definition: A single tree growing in a public right-of-way or along a road, inventoried by a city or forestry program with its species, trunk diameter at breast height, planting date and risk rating.

fields.name: siteId
fields.description: Planting-site identifier, stable when the tree is replaced

fields.name: cultivar
fields.description: Cultivar or variety (OpenTrees 'variety')

fields.name: dbh
fields.description: Trunk diameter at breast height

fields.name: riskRating
fields.description: Overall risk rating from a tree risk assessment

fields.name: stature
fields.description: Mature size class, e.g. small/medium/large

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: OpenTrees crosswalk schema (scientific, genus, species, variety, common, dbh, planted, updated) plus the New Haven URI street tree inventory (GlobalID, SiteID, Species, Genus, Family, Cultivar, COMM_NAME, DBH, PLNT_DATE, INV_DATE, RISKRATE, TreeStature, Address, LAT/LONG).

concepts.definition: A residential development or building in which some or all dwelling units are income-restricted or publicly subsidized (inclusionary below-market-rate units, tax-credit financing, public housing), counted by unit size and income ceiling.

fields.name: projectId
fields.description: Program identifier, e.g. HUD_ID or public housing development code

fields.name: affordableUnits
fields.description: Units that are income-restricted or subsidized

fields.name: incomeCeiling
fields.description: Income limit of the restricted units, e.g. 60% AMI

fields.name: yearCompleted
fields.description: Year placed in service or completed

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields shared by HUD LIHTC (HUD_ID, PROJECT, N_UNITS, LI_UNITS, N_0BR..N_4BR, INC_CEIL, YR_PIS), HUD Public Housing Developments (DEVELOPMENT_CODE, TOTAL_UNITS, TOTAL_OCCUPIED), New Haven BMR (unit counts by bedroom, ami) and CT DOH Housing Production (units, completion date).

concepts.definition: A property where hazardous substances or petroleum have been, or may have been, released into soil or groundwater, tracked by a state remediation or brownfield program with its program, cleanup stage, status and any use restrictions.

fields.name: siteId
fields.description: State site identifier, e.g. STE-0000002362

fields.name: caseNumber
fields.description: Remediation case number; one site can have several cases

fields.name: name
fields.description: Site or case name; often a business, sometimes a person's name

fields.name: program
fields.description: Remediation or brownfield program, e.g. LUST, BRRP, ABC, Transfer Act

fields.name: programDate
fields.description: Date the site entered or was approved in the program

fields.name: useRestrictions
fields.description: Environmental use restriction recorded

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields shared by CT DEEP's list of contaminated or potentially contaminated sites (REACT: site id, case number, program, status, cleanup stage, use restrictions) and CT DEEP/DECD Brownfields 2025 (Site_Name, Site_Addre, Site_Town, Program, Program_Ap, Parcel_Acr, Funding_So, Latitude/Longitude).

concepts.definition: An area designated by a local commission, the state or the National Register for preservation because of its historic or architectural character, with the year it was established; exterior changes inside it may need review.

fields.name: designationType
fields.description: Who designated it: local (LD), state or National Register

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from New Haven's historic district layers (HistoricDistrict, Type, YearEstablished); the local, state and National Register layers share this schema.

concepts.definition: A publicly used green space or recreation property, such as a playground, golf course, town green or community center grounds, with its category, owner, whether the recreation department manages it, and the land parcels it occupies.

fields.name: category
fields.description: e.g. Pocket, Neighborhood, Special

fields.name: ownerType
fields.description: Kind of owner, e.g. Municipal, State, Board of Education

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from New Haven's Comprehensive Parks layer (id_text, park_name, category, owner, parks_managed, public_, on_historic_registry, parcel_id list).

concepts.definition: An official addressable location kept by a municipality's addressing authority: house number, street name parts, unit, ZIP and neighborhood, placed as a point geometry at the structure or entrance it identifies.

fields.name: streetType
fields.description: Suffix type, e.g. ST, AVE

sourceAttribution.sourceNotes: Fields from New Haven's authoritative address points, which follow the Esri address data model (house_number, prefix_direction, street_name, suffix_type, suffix_direction, full_street_name, unit, unit_type, building_name, neighborhood, city, state_abbreviation, zip, zip4, type, unique_id).

sources.title: NOAA CO-OPS New Haven, CT tide & met station 8465705
sources.publisher: NOAA Center for Operational Oceanographic Products and Services
sources.recordDescription: One timestamped observation (water level, wind, air/water temperature, pressure) or tide prediction at the New Haven harbor station.
sources.license: US government public domain; no key
sources.note: Fields from a real datagetter response (water_level, 2026-10-13). product, datum, units and time_zone are request parameters, not fields. Other products (air_temperature, wind, air_pressure, water_temperature, predictions) share t/v/f; wind adds s,d,dr,g.

fields.name: metadata.id
fields.description: Station id (8465705)

fields.name: metadata.lat
fields.description: Latitude, decimal degrees as text

fields.name: metadata.lon
fields.description: Longitude, decimal degrees as text

fields.name: data.t
fields.description: Timestamp 'YYYY-MM-DD hh:mm' in the requested time_zone

fields.name: data.v
fields.description: Value, in the requested units and datum

fields.name: data.s
fields.description: Sigma (standard deviation of 1-second samples)

fields.name: data.f
fields.description: Data flags, comma-separated

fields.name: data.q
fields.description: Quality: p = preliminary, v = verified

sources.title: USGS 01196573 Quinnipiac River at Fair Haven — continuous water quality
sources.recordDescription: One latest value of one time series (parameter) at the monitoring location.
sources.license: US government public domain; no key (key optional for higher rate)
sources.note: Fields from a real OGC API-Features response (latest-continuous, 2026-10-13); one feature per time series. value is text. Only active USGS continuous site in New Haven.

fields.name: geometry
fields.description: GeoJSON Point of the monitoring location

fields.name: parameter_code
fields.description: USGS parameter code, e.g. 00010 water temperature

fields.name: statistic_id
fields.description: USGS statistic code, e.g. 00011 instantaneous

sources.title: Water Quality Portal (EPA/USGS/NWQMC) — New Haven area stations & results
sources.publisher: National Water Quality Monitoring Council (EPA WQX + USGS)
sources.recordDescription: Station endpoint: one monitoring location; Result endpoint: one measured characteristic value from one sampling activity.
sources.note: Fields are the WQX Station profile columns (accessUrl) plus the narrowResult profile columns from /data/Result/search (same bBox, mimeType=csv), from real downloads. Station rows are sites; Result rows are values.

sources.title: EPA AirNow current monitor data (ArcGIS) — New Haven Criscuolo Park 09-009-0027
sources.recordDescription: One monitoring site-hour with ozone, PM2.5, PM10 concentrations and AQI values.
sources.license: US government public data; preliminary, unvalidated

sources.title: CT DEEP Spill Incidents (July 2022–present)
sources.publisher: CT DEEP Emergency Response and Spill Prevention Division
sources.recordDescription: One reported release of a substance to the environment (spill, sewage overflow, dielectric fluid, etc.).
sources.note: Dates are text 'YYYY/MM/DD hh:mm AM'. Sewage incidents are the only open proxy for sewer overflows. Older history: wr2a-rnsg (1996-2022-06).

sources.title: New Haven Street Trees (URI / GreenSpace inventory)
sources.publisher: Urban Resources Initiative (Yale School of the Environment) — hosted in Yale ArcGIS Online org
sources.recordDescription: One street tree (point) inventoried or planted, with species, DBH, risk assessment and planting date.
sources.note: 32,553 points; last edited 2021. Species/Genus/Family are often empty; COMM_NAME is filled. DBH appears to be inches. Contains staff-name and editor fields.

sources.title: Brownfields 2025
sources.recordDescription: One brownfield site (CGS 32-760) in a state program (ABC, BRRP, etc.) with parcel id, acreage and funding sources.
sources.license: CT Geodata Portal (public, no license stated)
sources.note: Site_Parce is the town's parcel id; for New Haven it matches the Vision PID (parcel layer parcel_id).

sources.title: List of Contaminated or Potentially Contaminated Sites
sources.recordDescription: One remediation case (LUST, property transfer, etc.) at a site, with program, status and cleanup stage.
sources.note: Case-level: several cases per site. No parcel id; join by address or coordinates.

sources.title: Below Market Rate (BMR) Housing
sources.publisher: City of New Haven (Economic Development; custodian IT GIS)
sources.recordDescription: One property (address/parcel) in New Haven that contains below-market-rate units, with unit counts by bedroom size and AMI tier.
sources.license: City of New Haven item terms: no special restrictions; provided as-is, no liability (no open-data license named)
sources.updateFrequency: Irregular (update log: AMI field 2023, points added 2024+; last edit 2026)
sources.note: Joins the city parcel layer by vision_pid = parcel_id and mblu. Has property-manager phone/website fields (business contacts).

sources.title: Housing Production Report
sources.recordDescription: One DOH-supported affordable housing development/preservation project with cost, funding sources, units and AMI breakdown.
sources.note: No parcel id or coordinates; join to other housing lists by address/name and to towns by municipality.

sources.title: Low-Income Housing Tax Credit Properties
sources.recordDescription: One LIHTC-financed project with units, low-income units, bedroom mix, year placed in service and geocodes.
sources.note: TRACT_LEVEL lacks the leading zero ('9009140700'): pad to 11 characters. CURCOSUB is the county-subdivision FIPS (New Haven 52070). Has contact fields (CONTACT, CO_TEL).

sources.title: Public Housing Developments
sources.recordDescription: One public housing development of a housing authority with units, occupancy and aggregated resident characteristics.
sources.note: TRACT_LEVEL is the 11-digit 2020 tract GEOID on the old county (09009...) while CURCNTY is already the planning region (170). Has PHA staff contact fields.

sources.title: New Haven Local Historic Districts
sources.recordDescription: One local historic district boundary (Historic District Commission jurisdiction) with year established.
sources.license: City of New Haven AGOL (no license stated)

sources.title: Comprehensive Parks (Public View)
sources.recordDescription: One park or recreation property boundary (park, pocket park, community center, golf course) with owner, category, and whether Parks Dept manages it.
sources.license: City of New Haven item terms: no special restrictions; provided as-is, no liability (no open-data license named)
sources.note: parcel_id is a semicolon-separated list of Vision PIDs (split, then = parcel layer parcel_id).

sources.title: New Haven Addresses (Authoritative)
sources.recordDescription: One site address point (house number + street + optional unit) in New Haven, Esri address-model schema.
sources.license: City of New Haven item terms: no special restrictions; provided as-is, no liability (no open-data license named)
sources.note: parcel_join_id is empty in every row: link to parcels spatially or by address.

sources.title: Connecticut Protected Open Space Parcels
sources.publisher: CT Office of Policy and Management GIS Office / DEEP
sources.recordDescription: One parcel classified as protected open space, carrying the same CAMA attributes as the statewide parcel layer.
sources.landingPage: https://geodata.ct.gov/ (search 'Connecticut Protected Open Space Parcels'); data.ct.gov federated ryfg-xut8
sources.license: CT Geodata Portal (public, no license stated)
sources.updateFrequency: Tracks CAMA parcel layer refresh (last edit 2026-10)
sources.note: A filtered view of the statewide CAMA and parcel layer (same schema): parcels classed as protected open space.
